skill.summary: Forward/reverse geocoding and great-circle distance calculations.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of geocode-lookup.
- Supports forward (address to coordinates) and reverse geocoding (coordinates to address).
- Calculates distances using the Haversine formula with multiple unit options (km, mi, m, nm).
- Free tier available: 10 queries per day, no authentication required.
- Paid tier available via x402 protocol.
- Emphasizes privacy: no storage or logging of input data, minimal rate limiting with IP hashing only.
